title: Email: HD26 Snapshot for Products — 38 Cases as of 11:45

fields.to: Epidemiology Lead; Public Information Officer; Public Health Director
fields.subject: HD26 snapshot for products, AS OF 11:45, re-tiered for MRMC culture (EXERCISE MATERIAL)
fields.body:
All,

Master line list as of Mon 10/12 11:45: 38 coded cases (HD26-001 to HD26-038).

I've applied the MRMC GI PCR result for HD26-003 (specimen MR-ST-26-4471, Salmonella detected by PCR at 10:52; culture and serotyping pending). The tiers are now 1 confirmed, 30 probable, 7 suspect. Epi Lead, please sign off on the re-tier and on the working agent before anything goes out.

Earliest onset Sun 02:00, latest Mon 08:15. Onsets run from about 6 to 30 hours after the meal, with a tail. Curve by onset hour in 6-hour bins is attached.

One hospitalized (HD26-009, blood culture gram-negative rods, ID pending). 15 of the 38 were seen in the MRMC ED and meet the definition. No deaths.

Food: I still can't separate the coleslaw from the pasta salad, and the stratified run isn't done.

PIO, please use these numbers word for word in the holding statement, the exposure notice and the Health Advisory: "38 cases (1 confirmed, 30 probable, 7 suspect) as of 11:45 Monday."

Sunita, your noon post says 14. We have 15 of your ED patients on the list. Can you confirm, or tell me which one you'd drop?

The draft Health Advisory HAN-MCHD-2026-04 is attached. The numbered actions are blank.

Dev
fields.signature:
Dev Kulkarni
Backup Data Analyst, Epidemiology
Marlow County Health Department | Fenwick, Iowa
Main 555-0100 | Outbreak hotline 555-0150

instructorNote: Core inject. It sets a single count to use everywhere, and a Salmonella culture has been brought in early because the exercise compresses time. Watch for three things: the Epi Lead confirms the HD26-003 re-tier and locks "38 (1/30/7) as of 11:45"; the PIO uses that exact figure in every product; and the IP works out the 14 vs 15 ED patients with the Epi Lead and holds the noon MRMC post until the numbers match (COM-03 §5), with the Director approving the products.
